track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 20: Bayat Raje
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Bayat Raje in Bayat-e Esfahan, Nava. Its tonic is its own voted finalis. Tonic named F#: Alizadeh's setar sits within about 20 cents of A440 across his radif albums, so this finalis is a real F sharp, not a natural note on an instrument tuned away from A440.
